predecessor_disposition.DG10_review_source: PR #445 review: 22/22 StateShape (state,serve) pairs map exactly to the 22 frozen family pairs

v4_engine.candidate_generation: State resource law, serve-work law, capability atoms, routing, sharing, retrieval, serve iteration, stochasticity, verifier, authority and update locality are generated as independent factors from a target-vector-free hash sampler.
v4_engine.state_serve_measurement: Candidates store integer resource expressions, not state_scales_with/serve_scales_with labels. Labels are inferred after execution from 19 fixed asymmetric numeric probe worlds by exact trace matching.
v4_engine.distractors: Both resource-law sets contain non-target laws that classify UNCLASSIFIED_*; the search space is not just the 22 frozen target pairs.
v4_engine.coverage: 1,000,000 scored stochastic candidates per cell is the registered K4 stochastic cap from the original freeze. V4 is not claimed exhaustive over its much larger factorized space.
v4_engine.expressibility_witness: The frozen target vector may construct one grammar witness only after search ranking has completed. The witness is never inserted into the ranked stream and exists only to distinguish grammar/search failure from a concrete cheaper-parent THEORY_RED.
v4_engine.red_rule: If the best recovered non-target realization is admissible and has strictly lower total lifecycle cost than the admissible target-vector witness, THEORY_RED is licensed without exhaustive search because it is a concrete counterexample to frontier optimality.
v4_engine.green_rule: K4_RECOVERY_GREEN requires target-vector recovery, negative-twin vector flip, all known controls recovered and >=1,000,000 scored candidates.

public_beacon_rule.network: League of Entropy drand quicknet mainnet
public_beacon_rule.selection: Use exactly the first quicknet round whose round timestamp is at least 900 seconds after the GitHub committed_at timestamp of THIS V4 freeze commit.

protected_rule: No V4 protected task may execute until the one-shot V4 public beacon receipt exists. Any V4 development seed/run before that beacon is development-only and excluded from the aggregate.
claim_ceiling: V4 can test the original 22 property predictions without the DG-10 pre-paired-resource-axis leak. Same-author semantic evaluator, meter bucketing and primitive selection remain limitations; a V4 green array alone cannot flip the global known-form or no-gap terminals.
